Final for Publication

TYPE 1 PROJECT NARRATIVE - REZONING
Property: 2735 W. North Avenue, Chicago, IL 60647 | PIN: 16-01-200-004-0000

Ward: 26th Ward

Applicant: 360 Degrees LLC (Michael Hodges)
Owner: Hassan Azarpira, Property Match USA LLC

Proposed Map Amendment: B1-3 — C1-3 (Type 1) | Zoning Map No.: 3-I

Project Overview

Adaptive reuse of an existing one-story commercial building for an adult-use cannabis
dispensary. The proposal does not increase building height or FAR and makes no changes to
curb cuts. Loading occurs off-peak via Fairfield/alley, with all waste secured within a locked
trash enclosure. The site is transit-rich with strong pedestrian access.

Type 1 Description — Required Metrics (a-f)

(a) Proposed land use: Adult-Use Cannabis Dispensary (retail; Special Use in C1-3). No
on-site consumption.

(b) Floor Area Ratio (FAR): 4,342 sf (above grade) + 11,880 sf (lot) = 0.37. (Existing)

(c) Density (lot area per dwelling unit): Not applicable — 0 dwelling units
(non-residential use).

(d) Off-street parking (amount): Provided: 0 spaces. Required: 0 spaces required under
§17-10-0207, Parking Group M for “-3” districts (no spaces required for the first 10,000 sf;
retail/cannabis classified as Group M).

(e) Setbacks: Front 0' / Corner side 0' / West 0' / East 0' / Rear 3'-3" minimum (varies)
(Existing)

(f) Building height(s): 1 story, 14'-0". (Existing)
